headline: Praxis Home Retail Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting
sum: Outcome of Board Meeting - Praxis Home Retail Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors have approved the proposal for Rights issue at its meeting held on September 11, 2026.
